High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench At Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned advocates for the parties.
2. This is an application made by the cross-objectors for condonation of 596 days delay caused in filing the cross- objection in the first appeal.
The reasons have been stated in the application.

3. Learned AGP for respondent Nos.1 and 2, relying upon a decision in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Rameshwar @ Ramesh Chandra Sharma (Dead), through Legal Heir and Another [2022 SCC Online SC 1599], submits that delay may be condoned, subject to condition that the original land owners/claimants/cross- objectors herein shall not be entitled to get statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act,
-2- 22.CAO.330.2024.odt 1894 on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period.
